en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European market square with tram tracks running through a cobbled street. On the left is an arched passageway with posters and a standing figure in shadow. On the right are tall historic buildings with gabled facades and window boxes. In the distance stands a church-like tower with a clock and baroque spire rising above surrounding houses. Outdoor tables or stalls line the square. Handwritten-style German text is printed beneath the image.
